description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for visualizing git log graphs with octopus merges, including functions for comparing graph outputs and various test scenarios involving complicated merge graphs with colors and crossover patterns.

methods.name: test_cmp_graph
methods.description: Compares actual git log graph output with expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp_colored_graph
methods.description: Compares colored git log graph output with expected colored output.
